svg.title: Parity with the JS SDK, area by area
svg.desc: One mark per row of the tables of docs/parity.md, grouped by area. Documents and writes: 15 supported, 1 partial, 3 not applicable; Queries and filters: 9 supported; Aggregations: 3 supported; Listeners and snapshot options: 9 supported; Transactions and batches: 6 supported; Offline persistence and cache settings: 6 supported, 2 not applicable; Indexes: 4 supported, 1 not supported; Bundles: 2 supported; Lite: 4 supported, 1 not supported; Pipelines: 6 supported, 3 partial, 1 not supported; Multi-tab or multi-client: 1 supported, 1 partial, 2 not supported; App Check: 1 supported, 1 not supported; Emulator: 2 supported, 1 not applicable; Web transports: 7 supported, 1 not applicable; Platforms: 1 supported, 3 partial, 2 not applicable.
svg.text: Parity with the Firestore JS SDK: one mark per feature row of this page
Supported includes the rows marked preview, experimental, extra or Enterprise edition. Read the tables below for
what each partial or missing row lacks; the Known limitations list the gaps inside supported rows.
